# Chennuru Tejith

> Chennuru Tejith is an Indian business student pursuing an integrated BBA (Hons.) + MBA at O.P. Jindal Global University (2024–2029, CGPA 7.9/8), from Hyderabad, with internship experience in operations at Round Table India, project management at Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. and finance at Ion Exchange India Ltd.

Last updated: 2026-10-10

## Key facts
- Programme: Integrated BBA (Hons.) + MBA, O.P. Jindal Global University, Sonipat (Aug 2024 – Aug 2029), CGPA 7.9 / 8.00
- Operations Intern, Round Table India (Jun 2026 – Jul 2026 · Hyderabad): Monitored on-site execution of a ₹4 Cr CSR-funded government school construction project (MPPS & ZPHS Integrated School, Phase II) across 23 site visits over 7 weeks, tracking progress against sanctioned drawings.
- Project Management Intern, Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. (Jun 2025 – Jul 2025 · Hyderabad): Conducted employee cost analysis across FY2021–FY2025, tracking trends in salaries, share-based payments, and welfare expenses to support cost-optimization discussions.
- Finance Intern, Ion Exchange India Ltd. (Dec 2024 – Jan 2025 · Hyderabad): Streamlined daily transaction processing, improving departmental workflow efficiency and reducing documentation backlogs.

## Research
- From SEO to GEO: Navigating the Paradigm Shift from Search Engine Optimization to Generative Engine Optimization in the AI-First Search Era (Research paper, In progress): Argues that Generative Engine Optimization replaces SEO rather than evolving from it, and proposes the GEO Business Adoption Framework (GEO-BAF). Primary research compares how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and Perplexity choose and disclose their sources.

## GEO-BAF applied to this site
1. Readiness audit (done): Tested what an AI crawler sees without JavaScript. Before: almost nothing. After: about 970 words and 8 of 9 key facts on the home page, 9 of 9 on the text profile.
2. Foundational signals (done): Plain-HTML profile with question-led headings, llms.txt, ProfilePage / Person / FAQPage structured data, a visible last-updated date, and robots.txt that welcomes AI crawlers.
3. Platform-specific calibration (next): Once live: Bing Webmaster Tools (feeds ChatGPT search), Google Search Console (Gemini), and consistent facts across LinkedIn and GitHub for corroboration.
4. Measurement and embedding (next): Re-run the paper's own replication protocol on "Who is Chennuru Tejith?" across all five assistants, tracking inclusion, weighting and accuracy.
